# Repos that release.yml's notify-downstream repository_dispatches `upstream-release`
# {tag, version, sha} to on a busbar release. Each repo has its own release-on-upstream
# workflow (plus a daily-cron fallback) that re-pins to `sha`, bumps its own version, and
# publishes. One line per downstream repo.
